subject: Regional replica soak — temporary credit uplift request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam@edgescale.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:24:00 +0100
Subject: Regional replica soak — temporary credit uplift request

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Quick one — we're planning a 48h replica soak for our European footprint to validate cross-region failover, KV-cache warmup behavior, and end-to-end latency under sustained traffic. Goal is to simulate our production weekend peak: ~1,200 concurrent requests at ~40 tokens/request average for a 48-hour window (rough estimate: ~4M tokens).

We hit a credit ceiling on the trial project and will need a short-term uplift (promo or trial extension) to run the test Sept 18–19. Can Redwood provision a temporary top-up or one-off promo credit for the POC? We'll run traffic from our harness (Ops team) and share logs.

Attachments: traffic_plan_v1.xlsx (traffic shape + warmup timeline)

Happy to jump on a 15m call if you want details.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connell
Head of Platform Engineering
EdgeScale Analytics
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connell <liam@edgescale.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Regional replica soak — temporary credit uplift request

Thanks Liam — this is helpful. A few quick clarifying Qs before I escalate to credits team:

- Can you confirm peak RPS and whether the 1,200 figure is concurrent connections or aggregated requests/sec?
- Do you need the uplift in the eu-west-1 region only, or in multiple EU regions?
- Will you be using our streaming endpoint or standard completion endpoints for the test?

If you can reply with those details I can request a short-term promo top-up. We typically approve a one-off allowance tied to a HubSpot record and tag the allocation so it auto-expires. If you prefer, we can also schedule the run outside of business hours to minimize impact.

I can authorize an initial discretionary uplift for a scaled smoke run (non-production) while Marissa signs off on the full 48h allowance.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: Liam O'Connell <liam@edgescale.ai>

Cc: ops@edgescale.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 07:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Regional replica soak — temporary credit uplift request

Thanks Jonas — answers below:  

- 1,200 concurrent is our expected peak sessions; aggregated sustained request rate will be ~900 reqs/sec for the 48h plateau after warmup (so ~30–40 tokens/req average).
- Primary target is eu-west-1, but we may replicate a small fraction (~15% of traffic) to eu-central for failover validation.
- We'll use the standard completion endpoint (batch-style calls, not streaming) for the bulk of the run.

I've attached an updated plan with clarified traffic windows and an S3 link for the harness results (traffic_plan_v2.xlsx). We're happy to accept the smoke allowance first and then proceed to the full 48h test once credits are confirmed.

S3 logs will be uploaded to s3://edgescale-poc/soak-sep18/ — we'll share presigned links before the run.

Appreciate the quick help — LMK when you escalate.

—Liam
